events.verdict: Carter Jr. (ORL) maintains a legal guarding position during Collier's (UTA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Carter Jr. (ORL) steps into George (UTA) and initiates contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Bane's (ORL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Penda (ORL) rests a hand against Mykhailiuk (UTA) during his shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Bailey (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Bane's (ORL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Black (ORL) extends a hand into George (UTA) as he receives the pass.
Collier (UTA) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) arm, which affects his post shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Black (ORL) jumps vertically and absorbs the body contact initiated by Collier (UTA) during his shot attempt. Black lowers his arm down to contest and the contact with Collier after the release is marginal.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) initiates contact with Carter Jr. (ORL) that dislodges him from his position. The illegal contact occurs prior to Bane's (ORL) upward shooting motion.
Penda (ORL) makes contact with the ball while it is still in the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Bane (ORL) initiates illegal contact with Love's (UTA) head during the layup attempt.
George (UTA) initiates contact with Banchero's (ORL) wrist, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) jumps alongside George (UTA) and the contact as he makes the pass is marginal.
Penda (ORL) legally contests Bailey's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) drives through George (UTA) and dislodges him from his position.
Bane (ORL) gets his hand on the ball and the marginal contact is created by Collier (UTA) hooking Bane's arm.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) legally contests Black's (ORL) dunk attempt. The marginal contact is created by Black bracing for contact with his off-arm.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and George (UTA) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact between the two players is incidental.
Collier (UTA) commits a take foul on Black (ORL).
Black (ORL) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards George (UTA) and initiates contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Love (UTA) legally contests Bane's (ORL) layup attempt.

Black (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the ball goes out of bounds with 0.2 seconds remaining on the game clock.
